results.detail: A linear-size width-3 XOR-chain projects to even parity; any logically equivalent auxiliary-free CNF over the surviving n semantic variables requires at least 2^(n-1) clauses.
An explicit S-fixed 6-variable/8-clause 3CNF has delta*=2, both v=2 cofactors have delta*=1, but exact Davis-Putnam projection has delta*=3. Disjoint unions give arbitrarily large lifts.

current_mathematical_diagnosis.positive_fact: A polynomially computable strict rank already exists branchwise after S(F): maximal deficiency delta* falls on both Boolean cofactors.
current_mathematical_diagnosis.negative_fact: Natural exact recombination either reifies the binary choice with a selector, explodes under auxiliary-free full projection, or can rebound the delta* rank under Davis-Putnam projection.
current_mathematical_diagnosis.missing_object: A polynomial-size exact merge/projection state with a separately proved global descent rank and no hidden nondeterministic choice debt.
